stories.title: La caisse maladie "à vocation publique" franchit une étape à Genève

en.title: Public-vocation health insurance fund advances in Geneva
en.summary: Geneva's public-vocation health insurance fund is progressing through regulatory steps. The State Council announced a tender for an administrator and another for a health network, with an implementation target of early 2028 at the earliest.

stories.title: Harvey Weinstein à nouveau condamné, cette fois à 15 ans de prison

en.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced again, this time to 15 years in prison
en.summary: Harvey Weinstein, the 74-year-old former Miramax founder, received an additional 15-year prison sentence in New York for sexual assault against a former production assistant, following his 2020 conviction of 23 years that was overturned on appeal.

stories.title: Äthiopien: In Tigray sprechen wieder die Waffen – bereits vor einigen Jahren starben hier Hunderttausende

en.title: Ethiopia: Weapons speak again in Tigray—hundreds of thousands died here years ago
en.summary: Armed conflict has resumed in Ethiopia's Tigray region as the regional government declares a defensive struggle and major opposition groups have formed an alliance against Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's government, risking international escalation.

stories.title: Devant l'ONU, Massoud Pezeshkian affirme que l'Iran a été "victime du terrorisme"

en.title: Before the UN, Massoud Pezeshkian states that Iran has been "victim of terrorism"
en.summary: Iran's President Massoud Pezeshkian told the UN that Iran has been a victim of terrorism, referring to military operations by the United States and Israel, while warning that his country will never surrender.

stories.title: Harvey Weinstein de nouveau condamné à une peine de prison pour agression sexuelle

en.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced again to prison for sexual assault
en.summary: Harvey Weinstein, the former Hollywood producer, received a 15-year prison sentence in New York for sexual assault against a former production assistant. The conviction follows eight years of legal proceedings.

stories.title: Un rempart gaulois découvert près de Notre-Dame confirmerait que Lutèce se situait bien sur l’île de la Cité (et pas à Nanterre)

en.title: A Gallic rampart discovered near Notre-Dame confirms that Lutèce was located on the Île de la Cité (not in Nanterre)
en.summary: Archaeologists discovered a 22-meter-long Gallic wall from the first century BCE in the courtyard of the Hôtel-Dieu. Paris officials describe it as one of the most significant archaeological discoveries in the city's history.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Rubio: Russland und Ukraine interessiert an Energie-Feuerpause

en.title: War in Ukraine - Rubio: Russia and Ukraine interested in energy ceasefire
en.summary: The U.S. Secretary of State met with his Russian counterpart at the UN General Assembly. They discussed the possibility of an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine.

stories.title: «Ce choix politique n’est pas un compromis», estime UBS après le vote au Conseil des Etats sur ses fonds propres

en.title: "This political choice is not a compromise", says UBS after the States Council vote on its capital
en.summary: Switzerland's States Council voted to require UBS to maintain CET1 capital at 90% for foreign subsidiaries, below the government's requested 100%. UBS and business groups expressed concerns about competitiveness impacts.

stories.title: Un rempart gaulois trouvé en plein Paris éclaire les origines de Lutèce

en.title: A Gallic rampart found in central Paris sheds light on the origins of Lutèce
en.summary: Archaeologists uncovered a 20-meter Gallic rampart dating over 2,000 years old in central Paris during summer excavations. The discovery may provide the first evidence of the city's ancient Gallic origins.

stories.title: UBS fait la moue après le vote du Conseil des Etats sur ses fonds propres

en.title: UBS frowns upon the States Council vote on its capital
en.summary: UBS expressed displeasure with the States Council's decision to require 90% capital coverage for its foreign subsidiaries. The bank issued a critical statement following Wednesday's parliamentary vote.

stories.title: Défaite pour UBS: le Conseil des Etats veut une couverture des filiales étrangères couverte par 90% de fonds propres

en.title: Defeat for UBS: the States Council wants foreign subsidiaries covered by 90% capital
en.summary: The States Council voted Wednesday to require UBS to cover foreign subsidiaries with 90% capital, below the Federal Council's 100% request. The outcome represents a setback for UBS's lobbying efforts.

stories.title: 6,5 Milliarden Euro pro Jahrgang: So teuer ist in Deutschland der vorzeitige Abschied in die Rente

en.title: 6.5 billion euros per cohort: Early retirement without deductions is this expensive in Germany
en.summary: Germany's government is considering maintaining penalty-free early retirement after 45 contribution years, with studies indicating substantial costs that disproportionately benefit higher earners.

stories.title: Ein «extremer Sonderweg» oder ein «gelungener Kompromiss»? Das sagen Experten zu den Kapitalregeln für die UBS

en.title: An "extreme outlier" or a "successful compromise"? Experts comment on UBS capital rules
en.summary: Stricter capital requirements approved by Switzerland's upper chamber for UBS have generated conflicting expert opinions, with underlying disagreements about the rules remaining entrenched.

stories.title: Lex UBS: «Man kann nicht sämtliche Risiken wegregulieren», sagt die Finanzministerin im Parlament

en.title: Lex UBS: "You cannot regulate away all risks," Finance Minister tells Parliament
en.summary: UBS must now back its foreign holdings with 90 percent hard equity capital, a requirement approved by the upper chamber. The measure now moves to the lower chamber after UBS initially opposed it.

stories.title: Warum Chinas Staatspräsident Xi Jinping eine Wirtschaftsdelegation mit nach Washington nimmt

en.title: Why China's President Xi Jinping is bringing an economic delegation to Washington
en.summary: Despite US sanctions against numerous Chinese companies, leading Chinese tech firms are accompanying Xi to the United States in hopes of gaining access to the American market.

stories.title: Kann Superstar Kylian Mbappé die Sportmarke On aus dem Formtief führen?

en.title: Can superstar Kylian Mbappé lead sportswear brand On out of its slump?
en.summary: On is entering the multi-billion dollar football market through a partnership with Mbappé, though the Zurich-based company faces challenges in its core business.
